# HumanOS Runtime UseCases

> A collection of self-contained HumanOS IoT Runtime integration examples for industrial automation. Each use case is a deployable HumanOS IoT Designer project (.h2proj) demonstrating a specific connector, protocol, or feature pattern — covering REST API orchestration, CNC machine connectivity, MQTT/SparkPlug B messaging, and threshold-based alerting.

## Overview

- [README](README.md): Index of all use cases, required tooling, and links to the HumanOS Runtime reference manual.

## Use Cases

- [Ansible Agent](src/AnsibleAgent/Readme.md): Integrates Ansible Semaphore via REST API (WebControl connector) into HumanOS Platform Pipelines. Provisions Semaphore resources idempotently, starts playbook tasks, polls for completion, and returns structured JSON feedback via the HumanOS workflow engine.
- [DMG Mori Seiki](src/MoriSeiki/Readme.md): Acquires real-time machine data (axis positions, spindle state, program execution, part counter) from older DMG Mori Seiki CNC controllers via a native TCP/IP stream (port 7878, TcpClientControl connector). Parses a pipe-delimited ASCII payload and maps it to the HumanOS OEE information model; exposes acquired data via OPC-UA.
- [FANUC Data Aggregation](src/FANUC.DataAggregation/Readme.md): Aggregates FANUC CNC controller signals (availability, program name, operation mode, part counter) into a unified entity node using the DataAggregator processing network without any C# scripting; pre-configured for the FANUC NCGuide simulator, no physical hardware required.
- [FANUC Robot OPC-UA Bridge](src/FanucRobotOpcUa/Readme.md): Connects a FANUC R-30iB Plus robot controller via its built-in OPC-UA interface (NanoUaServer) and re-publishes all robot telemetry (axis positions, torques, alarms, Modbus arrays) through the HumanOS OPC-UA server. Follows the OPC-UA for Robotics information model.
- [FLAMES Demo](src/FLAMESDemo/Readme.md): Implements the FLAMES OPC-UA companion specification for machine tool automation, covering production management, tool data exchange, and automation state. Includes three C# state machines (Production, Transport, OccupancyReconciliation), OPC-UA event publishing, dynamic FileSystem, and tool data management; runs on a JSON file simulator with no hardware required.
- [Fraisa ToolExpert](src/Fraisa.ToolExpert/Readme.md): Queries the FRAISA ToolExpert cloud REST API by article number (WebControl connector) and exposes the parsed tool data as an OPC-UA command node.
- [ML Image Classification](src/ML.ImageClassification/Readme.md): Classifies frames from a USB webcam in real time using a ResNet-18 ONNX model and the HumanOS Machine Learning plugin (HumanOS.PeMiL.MachineLearning, TNeuralNetworkProcessor). A processing network preprocesses each frame (decode, resize to 224×224, ImageNet normalization into an NCHW tensor) via a C# script, runs inference (CPU or GPU), then maps the argmax of the score vector to an ImageNet label above a confidence threshold; the predicted label is published as DetectedClassification over OPC-UA. Requires a webcam; no other hardware.
- [Siemens S7 Complex Data](src/SiemensS7.ComplexData/Readme.md): Reads a structured DataBlock from a Siemens S7 PLC and automatically maps it to a typed OPC-UA node using a custom EntityType, without any C# scripting; demonstrates no-code complex data acquisition from big-endian PLC memory.
- [Sinumerik 840D PowerLine](src/SinumerikPowerLine/Readme.md): Connects a Siemens Sinumerik 840D PL CNC controller (SinumerikControl connector, s840d.pl:// protocol) with two templates: DNC bi-directional NC-program/tool-data exchange and OEE/MDE production data acquisition.
- [Smart Factory Simulator](src/SmartFactorySimulator/Readme.md): Simulates a complete smart factory with two AGV robots, two test machines, and a storage unit, all orchestrated by the HumanOS workflow engine. Robots fetch waypoints from the vHub cloud API and navigate via vector interpolation; all telemetry is exposed via OPC-UA and a REST API on port 80; no hardware required.
- [SparkPlug Alarming](src/SparkPlugAlarming/Readme.md): Forwards active FANUC controller alarms (FanucControl connector) to MQTT clients via SparkPlug B. Serializes the AlarmEvent Pool to a JSON array every 30 seconds; the SparkPlug Client publishes on change.
- [TCP/IP Demo](src/TCPIPDemo/Readme.md): Connects any machine exposing data over a raw TCP/IP socket using the TcpClientControl connector. Parses semicolon-delimited CSV frames via a custom C# payload processor, derives OEE machine states and error severity classifications, and aggregates results for platform forwarding; includes a .NET test server simulator.
- [Temperature Reporter](src/TemperatureReporter/Readme.md): Demonstrates the OnThreshold trigger type and TThresholdCalculator class for multi-level temperature alerting (50 °C / 60 °C / 70 °C with hysteresis). Includes a file-based simulator; no hardware required.
- [Timing Example](src/TimingExample/Readme.md): Demonstrates timer-driven periodic command execution using HumanOS Timers, GenericRules, and TCommandHelper. A 2-second timer triggers a C# rule script that queries all connected devices and calls ReadFile on each; includes a file-based simulator; no hardware required.
- [Traub CNC OPC-UA Integration](src/Traub/Readme.md): Connects a Traub CNC turning machine via OPC-UA (OpcUaControl connector), derives OEE machine states from raw signals, and parses NC program headers for product/step metadata. Forwards aggregated data to the CyberTech platform, MQTT, Azure IoT Hub, and REST. Includes a self-contained TraubSimulator project that replicates the real Traub OPC-UA server.

## Key Source Files

- [AlarmProcessorScript.cs](src/SparkPlugAlarming/default/HumanOS.UHAL.DeviceDetectors/AlarmProcessorScript.cs): Reads the AlarmEvent Pool and serializes active alarms to a JSON array for SparkPlug transmission.
- [ctePayloadProcessor.cs](src/TCPIPDemo/Maschine/default/HumanOS.UHAL.TcpClientControl/ctePayloadProcessor.cs): Implements TAbstractStreamScriptObject to parse semicolon-delimited CSV frames from a TCP/IP stream, detect header vs. data lines, and map each field to HumanOS data nodes by position; normalizes time values to total minutes.
- [ImagePreprocessing.cs](src/ML.ImageClassification/default/HumanOS.UHAL.VideoCamera/ImagePreprocessing.cs): Decodes a JPEG webcam frame with SkiaSharp, resizes it to 224×224 and writes a channel-major (NCHW) Single[] tensor with ImageNet mean/std normalization for the ResNet-18 ONNX model.
- [ClassificationSelectionProcessor.cs](src/ML.ImageClassification/default/HumanOS.UHAL.VideoCamera/ClassificationSelectionProcessor.cs): Takes the argmax of the ResNet-18 score vector and, if it exceeds the ThresholdLevel, maps the class index to an ImageNet label (else "unknown"), publishing it as DetectedClassification.
- [JobOperation.cs](src/AnsibleAgent/Scripts/Workflows/JobOperation.cs): Async HumanOS workflow managing the full Ansible job lifecycle (start → poll → fetch output).
- [MoriSeikiPayloadProcessor.cs](src/MoriSeiki/default/HumanOS.UHAL.TcpClientControl/MoriSeikiPayloadProcessor.cs): Implements TAbstractStreamScriptObject to parse the DMG Mori Seiki native TCP stream (pipe-delimited ASCII, port 7878) and map key/value pairs to HumanOS data nodes; normalizes ON/OFF and AVAILABLE/UNAVAILABLE to boolean.
- [AlertProcessingScript.cs](src/TemperatureReporter/default/HumanOS.UHAL.FileReader/AlertProcessingScript.cs): Uses three TThresholdCalculator instances to evaluate multi-level temperature thresholds with hysteresis.
- [ProductionStateMachineScript.cs](src/FLAMESDemo/default/HumanOS.UHAL.FileReader/ProductionStateMachineScript.cs): Implements the FLAMES ProductionProgram state machine (Initialized → Running → Stopped → Aborted → Interrupted) and publishes a strongly-typed ProductionProgramTransitionEvent OPC-UA event on each transition.
- [ReportProcessingScript.cs](src/TemperatureReporter/default/HumanOS.UHAL.FileReader/ReportProcessingScript.cs): Logs temperature reports and forwards the value to downstream outputs.
- [RobotController.cs](src/SmartFactorySimulator/smartfactory/Scripts/Workflows/RobotController.cs): Async workflow loop that fetches robot waypoints from the vHub API on job change and simulates AGV movement via vector interpolation, updating position, odometer, and battery consumption at each step.
- [TestMachineController.cs](src/SmartFactorySimulator/smartfactory/Scripts/Workflows/TestMachineController.cs): Async workflow loop that polls the machine input tray for new jobs, processes parts one-by-one with a configurable cycle time delay, and writes the finished job to the output tray.
- [Timer_Script.cs](src/TimingExample/default/Scripts/Rules/Timer_Script.cs): Rule script triggered by OnTimer; queries all devices with a DriverId property via Kernel.NodeSpace.queryNodes and calls ReadFile on each via TCommandHelper, logging success or failure per device.
- [TMainProgramHeaderProcessorScript.cs](src/Traub/cte/default/Scripts/Processing/TMainProgramHeaderProcessorScript.cs): Parses the Traub NC main program header to extract OEEProductName from ;PRODUCT: and OEEProductionStep from ;STEP: comment lines.
- [UHAL_StartJob.cs](src/AnsibleAgent/HOS.AnsibleAgent1/HumanOS.UHAL.WebControl/UHAL_StartJob.cs): Idempotent Semaphore setup: logs in, creates or resolves all required resources, and starts the Ansible task.
- [ToolExpert_ImportResourceData.cs](src/Fraisa.ToolExpert/default/HumanOS.UHAL.WebControl/ToolExpert_ImportResourceData.cs): HTTP script that queries the FRAISA API by article number and returns parsed tool data.

## Documentation

- [HumanOS Runtime Reference Manual](https://doc.cybertech.swiss/runtime/intro): Full documentation for connectors, device templates, scripts, plugins, and deployment.
- [WebControl Connector Manual](https://doc.cybertech.swiss/runtime/Manuals/HumanOS.UHAL.WebControl/): REST API connector used in AnsibleAgent and FraisaToolExpert.
- [SparkPlug Client Manual](https://doc.cybertech.swiss/runtime/Manuals/HumanOS.PeSeL.SparkPlugClient/): MQTT SparkPlug B publisher used in SparkPlugAlarming.
- [Sinumerik Connector Manual](https://doc.cybertech.swiss/runtime/2.11/Manuals/HumanOS.UHAL.SinumerikControl/): CNC connector used in SinumerikPowerLine.
- [Trigger Types Reference](https://doc.cybertech.swiss/runtime/Manuals/HumanOS.Runtime/GenericInformationModelNodes/DataNodes.md#trigger-types): Documents OnThreshold, OnChange, and other trigger types used across use cases.
- [Tutorials](https://doc.cybertech.swiss/runtime/Tutorials/): Step-by-step guides from getting started to complex data types and WebService integration.

## Optional

- [OPC-UA Server Manual](https://doc.cybertech.swiss/runtime/Manuals/HumanOS.PeSeL.OPCUAServer/): Used as the service interface in FraisaToolExpert and available in all use cases.
- [HumanOS OEE Model](https://doc.cybertech.swiss/runtime/Models/HumanOS.OEE/): Standardized OEE information model used in SinumerikPowerLine.
- [HumanOS DNC Model](https://doc.cybertech.swiss/runtime/Models/HumanOS.DNC/): DNC information model for NC-program and tool-data exchange.
- [Machine Learning Plugin Manual](https://doc.cybertech.swiss/runtime/Manuals/HumanOS.PeMiL.MachineLearning/): ONNX neural-network inference processor used in ML Image Classification.
- [Video Camera Connector Manual](https://doc.cybertech.swiss/runtime/Manuals/HumanOS.UHAL.VideoCamera/): USB/PnP camera connector and processing-network host used in ML Image Classification.
- [Use Case Heidenhain (online)](https://doc.cybertech.swiss/runtime/UseCases/): Companion use case with full step-by-step setup guide including screenshots.
- [HumanOS Platform / Workflow Engine](https://doc.cybertech.swiss/platform/intro): Platform-level workflows and pipelines used in the AnsibleAgent use case.
